elements.name: Maintain constant ribbon height and non-premature compaction across tabs

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in a wide restored window
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed
the user switches across the 3D Model, Sketch, Tools, Manage, View, and Annotate tabs
the ribbon tab strip and command area retain the same height on every tab without vertical shift or a horizontal scrollbar
ribbon groups remain expanded whenever their combined width fits within the available ribbon width
the user narrows the window until groups must compact
compacted groups render as icon-and-label buttons with a dropdown indicator rather than blank placeholder boxes
